product.name: Period Panties
product.description: Underwear designed with built-in absorbent and leak-proof layers to manage menstrual flow for light, medium, and heavy periods.

product.name: Period Swimwear
product.description: Swimwear with integrated absorbent and leak-proof layers to allow women to swim confidently during menstruation.

product.name: Period Care Products
product.description: Intimate hygiene products including foaming lotion, deodorant spray, and nourishing serum formulated for external use during menstruation.
